ix_orders_delivered_partial.definition: CREATE INDEX ix_orders_delivered_partial ON olist.orders (customer_id) INCLUDE (order_purchase_timestamp, order_delivered_customer_date, order_estimated_delivery_date) WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL

ix_order_items_seller_order.definition: CREATE INDEX ix_order_items_seller_order ON olist.order_items (seller_id, order_id)
